items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; public exposure and security-sensitive releases are blocked; ordinary reversible growth is conditional. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No incident or exploitation is evidenced. TLS data reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but does not establish complete TLS safety. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public exposure or security-sensitive release and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix, retain private launch gates, block security-sensitive releases, and permit only bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data-handling boundaries. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue, or conduct outreach.

Maintain the existing private, preview-only gate for the gated product. The available security baseline does not evidence access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, release controls, monitoring, incident readiness, or disclosure readiness required for public exposure. Continue only the existing consolidated read-only evidence work; do not expand alerts, deploy, change configuration or credentials, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
